_comment: Dialable phone numbers/codes → events. Keys are matched case-INSENSITIVELY and with whitespace stripped. Fields: name (messenger; '' = no name shown, not localized), text (an id in lang/<code>/phone.json), sound (a stem in the STAGE's Sounds/ folder e.g. myroom/Sounds/egg.ogg, played with no message when there is no text), lines (a call of several messages, used instead of name/text: a list of { name, text, blip } shown one after the other; blip is the typing sound's stem in the stage's Sounds/ folder, and a line without a name types with the narrator's unless it gives its own; an entry with a single text types with the narrator's too, or with its own blip field), effect ('bombs' = the Canabi bomb-storm), give (a furniture id handed over with the reward pop-up when none is placed or in stock; otherwise the call shows the 'quest_cleared' text). Any number NOT listed here falls back to the 'nobody picks up' placeholder. Add story-mode easter eggs here without touching code.
